latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Gamer News skill.
- Fetches and summarizes the latest video game news from leading gaming outlets, including IGN, Kotaku, GameSpot, Polygon, Eurogamer, Rock Paper Shotgun, VG247, Gematsu, and the PlayStation Blog.
- Supports both English and Korean keywords and triggers.
- Aggregates and deduplicates top stories, prioritizing outlets based on user interest (platform, region, business, reviews).
- Outputs up to 5 recent stories with brief summaries and original links; supports deeper summaries on request.
- Handles feed errors gracefully and notes missing sources if partial results are shown.
